records.issue_text: Diff-trimming loop (lines 100-108) can make `start > value.length() - end` when one string is a prefix/suffix of the other, causing `substring` to throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException and abort verification; clamp `end` to `min(value.length(), sanitized.length()) - start`
records.rationale: In VerifyMessageProperties.verifySafeHtml(), the diff-trimming computes `start` as the common prefix length and `end` as the common suffix length independently, without ensuring they don’t overlap. This can make `start > value.length() - end` (or similarly for sanitized) and cause `value.substring(start, value.length() - end)` / `sanitized.substring(...)` to throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.

records.issue_text: `file.getAbsolutePath().contains("email")` heuristic matches any parent directory containing 'email' (e.g. a developer's checkout path), changing verification behavior; should match on the theme sub-path `/email/messages/`
records.rationale: The diff introduces `normalizeValue()` with `if (file.getAbsolutePath().contains("email")) { ... }` to alter sanitization behavior. Because it matches on the *entire absolute path*, it can unintentionally trigger when any parent directory contains the substring `email`, not just when verifying `/email/messages/` theme files, thus changing verification results for unrelated files.
